Alice — thanks, and appreciate the clear timeline. High-level reply and proposed MAP milestones below. I'm sending this from our sales mailbox; copying Kimberley (security & legal ops) and Marcus (platform) to confirm exact artifacts.

Proposed MAP (milestones / dates)
- Sep 24: Redwood delivers SOC 2 Type II summary + bridge documentation and baseline SIG/CAIQ export (CSV)
- Sep 28: Redwood provides initial DPA redline (we’ll circulate via DocuSign link)
- Oct 1: Evidence intake session with HarborCore InfoSec (30m) - demonstration of data residency and retention modes
- Oct 6: Exec-level MAP signoff / go/no-go discussion

Acceptance criteria (security gates)
- SOC 2: Type II attestation covering control period Nov 2025–Apr 2026; we will provide auditor contact and redaction-friendly report by Sep 24
- SIG/CAIQ: we generally provide a full questionnaire export; for regulatory customers we will flag subset answers and offer a walkthrough. If HarborCore needs a curated CAIQ subset, please call out the controls you want prioritized
- DPA & retention: Redwood supports configurable retention windows by data class and can bind residency at deployment. Default hosted retention is 90 days for request logs; we can propose a dedicated retention lane for regulated tenants (archive-to-cold-storage, with SLA on retrieval).

Open items for your legal & compliance teams
- If HarborCore requires a >5 year retention for specific classes (payment settlement logs), we need to align on archival format, exportability, and cost model in the MAP (long‑term storage is treated as an add-on for Hosted customers).
- Need clarity whether HarborCore will accept a SOC 2 bridge and auditor letter in lieu of the full report for initial executive review (we can provide full report under NDA).

Attachments we will send by Sep 24: SOC2-Attestation-202605.pdf (redaction-ready), SIG-CAIQ-export.csv, Draft-DPA-Redline-HarborCore.docx

Logistics: Kimberley — can you confirm DPA redline timeline and whether legal can accept DocuSign? Marcus — please note residency & retention lane options we should show in the Oct 1 intake.

Thanks — Logan
